name: chronos
description: A local daemon that runs AI coding agents unattended, and supervises them like a team
author: Leonel Fernandez

scripts.test: CHRONOS_TEST=1 CHRONOS_DB=:memory: CHRONOS_MAX_CONCURRENT=3 CHRONOS_DAILY_BUDGET=5 CHRONOS_RESUME_RL_MAX_HOURS=6 CHRONOS_DESKTOP_NOTIFY=0 CHRONOS_SANDBOX_DEFAULT=off CHRONOS_QUOTA_GATE=off node --import tsx --test 'src/**/*.test.ts' && node --test scripts/mc-help.test.mjs && npm run evals
scripts.deploy: node scripts/predeploy-backup.mjs && npm test && npm run build && launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/sh.chronos.daemon && sleep 3 && curl -s localhost:${CHRONOS_PORT:-7777}/api/health
